observations.body: Calling holds circumcision, slavery, and freedom in place. Only, as the Lord has distributed to each man, as God has called each, so let him walk. So I command in all the assemblies. Brothers, let each man, in whatever condition he was called, stay in that condition with God.

payload.posture: Read 1 Corinthians 7:17–24 as one movement in Paul's story, keeping the passage's actions, setting, sequence, and limits visible.
payload.tension: The passage states calling holds circumcision, slavery, and freedom in place. Only, as the Lord has distributed to each man, as God has called each, so let him walk. So I command in all the assemblies. Brothers, let each man, in whatever condition he was called, stay in that condition with God. It does not by itself supply every cause or later interpretation of this part of Paul's story.
